data.title: 8bit: add level 2 (east screen, more link-doors) + cave dungeon with about-me

data.body: Scope decided from repo evidence: Level 1 gains an exit (gap in a wall) leading to a second overworld screen. Level 2 holds a few more link-doors — LINKEDIN (https://www.linkedin.com/in/forrest-almasi, confirmed in marble/), plus on-domain doors RANDOM (/random/) and SOFTWARE (/software/) — and a cave mouth. Entering the cave loads a dungeon room (Zelda old-man style) containing a terse attract-mode ABOUT ME (Forrest Almasi, software developer) and a way back out. Room transitions are instant frame swaps (no camera, per BRANDING laws). 8bit/BRANDING.md must be extended to spec the multi-room map so future regens don't destroy the levels. Keep existing room/controls/door mechanics intact; collision maps stay ASCII-driven in script.js.

Implemented per plan: three static .room divs (room-1 west overworld with new east gap, room-2 east overworld with LINKEDIN/RANDOM/SOFTWARE gates + rock face + cave span + pond, room-3 dungeon with about-me plate, two eightbit-flicker fires, old man, south stair exit), hero moved to a pointer-transparent .field overlay, data-level frame-swap CSS, MAPS/EXITS/CAVE_DEST + warp()/caveEnter() + threshold() rewrite in script.js, .sr paragraph replaced by a nav listing all six destinations, BRANDING.md updated per plan §8 (regenerate-page hook ignored as instructed). Verified: scratchpad sanity script (3 maps x 11 rows x 16 chars, door letters GTELRS match data-door attrs, all EXITS destinations walkable, X/D tiles have walkable approaches, cave threshold walkable, BFS reachability of every door/gap, cave is a span and room-3 has no anchors) all pass; a fake-DOM Node harness ran the real SITES['8bit'] function and walked spawn -> east gap -> level 2 -> cave -> dungeon -> exit -> LINKEDIN door click -> west gap -> level 1, asserting data-level, hero position/facing, prompts and lit states — all pass; node build.js exits 0; built index.html has prefixed #site-8bit .stage[data-level] rules with no selector leaks; palette audit shows exactly the 16 tokens; only transition is the pre-existing reduced-motion guard; http.server curl checks of /8bit/, / and the /random/ + /software/ door targets all 200 with new markup. Committed as c43c191 (pre-existing FA-27 memphis work, as found) and 5a5ae03 (FA-28). Left undone: real-browser click-through (no browser available here); an unattributed working-tree edit to sites.config.json (vhs/isomorphic bucket swap, already reflected in the prior build) was left uncommitted per shared-worktree discipline.

REVIEW (FA-28, commit 5a5ae03): PASS. Reviewed cold against plan + acceptance criteria (plan §10). Verified independently: (1) maps — all three 11x16; level 1 byte-identical to pre-change map except X@(15,4); L2 doors L@(2,1) R@(7,1) S@(12,1), C@(11,4) with = threshold @(11,5), X@(0,4); L3 D@(8,10), fires/oldman/n-plate at planned coords; all EXITS destinations walkable, every X/D has an EXITS entry, flood-fill shows every door threshold, cave threshold and exit reachable from each level's entry. (2) node build.js exits 0 and leaves committed index.html unchanged (deterministic); built page: every selector in the 8bit style block is #site-8bit-prefixed including the data-level room rules; no leaks. (3) Contract audit: only the 16 palette hexes (incl. %23-encoded SVG fills); no transition property (outside the reduced-motion guard); all animations steps(); no easing keywords; no commas in functional pseudo-classes; keyframes eightbit- prefixed; zero element ids introduced; no window/document listeners; cave is a span (never an anchor, no hover/focus rules); all six doors are real anchors with correct hrefs (github.com/malls, twitter.com/forrestalmasi, mailto:_@forrestalmasi.com, linkedin.com/in/forrest-almasi, /random/, /software/); .sr nav lists all six. (4) State machine exercised via a fake-DOM harness driving the real script.js: focused prompt, door lighting + ^ ENTER prompt, Up clicks the anchor, > GO EAST / < GO WEST / ^ ENTER CAVE / v LEAVE CAVE prompts, warp east -> L2(1,4) facing right, cave -> dungeon (8,9) facing up with exit prompt visible on arrival, plate solid (tap-to-turn), D -> L2(11,5), west gap -> L1(14,4); held key continues walking across a warp (held not cleared, moving/entering reset by warp); a blur between the half-step and the queued warp still completes the warp and recomputes the prompt correctly; caveEnter/enter clear held so no re-trigger loops; hero sits in the pointer-events:none .field so door clicks pass through; no-JS default (data-level=1 in HTML) renders level 1 with three working doors; reduced-motion paths use 0ms warps and one-frame fires/water. (5) BRANDING.md updated per plan §8; page not regenerated. Findings, severity-ordered: [minor, not FA-28 code] the committed index.html was built with the sibling's uncommitted sites.config.json change (900/1000 vhs<->isomorphic swap), so a rebuild from committed sources alone changes index.html by 2 lines — self-heals when that sibling change is committed; left alone per worktree discipline. [cosmetic, pre-existing pattern] after blur while standing on a threshold the prompt keeps the contextual label instead of PRESS START — consistent with the pre-change door behavior. No inline fixes needed. All six acceptance criteria met. Verdict: PASS.
